layers.name: engine
layers.purpose: headless analysis: Node, type-stripped, no DOM, no bundler. Runs standalone as a CLI and depends on nothing above it

layers.name: shell
layers.purpose: Electron main and preload, CommonJS. Shells out to the engine CLI rather than importing it, so Electron's bundled Node never has to strip types

layers.name: renderer
layers.purpose: Chromium: React and three.js via Vite. Shares the engine's type vocabulary rather than redeclaring it, and reaches the shell only through the preload bridge
